fireBombSearch.Source Flags: Show only when bought; Event variant

readme: Filter Fire Bomb Search by any BR column, nation, aircraft, fire-bomb name, or quantity.
Use Loadout Detail for one row per aircraft, standard preset, and secondary weapon.
Quantity belongs to one valid standard preset. Maximum Quantity is the largest quantity found among that aircraft's listed standard presets.
A bomb is marked fire/incendiary when its source definition contains explosiveType=napalm, a fireDamage block, or a napalm icon.
BR is derived from the source economic rank using the same 0.0, 0.3, and 0.7 progression used by the dashboard dataset.
Source Flags identifies records such as NT, event, killstreak, or show-only-when-bought variants so the app can include or exclude them.
The workbook reports source-defined standard presets. It does not invent a higher quantity by combining separate custom-slot options.
Ready-to-filter aircraft and fire-bomb results with maximum quantity and best preset.
One row per aircraft or helicopter with BRs and fire-bomb availability.
One row per standard secondary-weapons preset.
Normalized aircraft–preset–weapon relationship table for app import.
Unique carried ordnance records and fire-bomb classification evidence.
